metadata.technology_reasoning: Real-Time PCR thermocyclers are the industry standard for quantitative polymerase chain reaction analysis as of 2024, featuring integrated thermal cycling and optical detection systems for DNA amplification monitoring. They have widespread adoption in clinical diagnostics, research, and biotech due to precise temperature control and fluorescence measurement capabilities.

components.reasoning: Core component responsible for rapid and precise temperature cycling essential to PCR amplification; universally present and procured as a separate module.
